capabilities: Capture ideas, tasks, clippings and drafts into designated vault notes
Aggregate daily todos and weekly work items in a task overview
Track recurring habit check-ins with configurable items and import/export
Record Moments notes into yearly files with search, filters and share images
Show time progress, daily quotes, weather and vault statistics
extras: Freemium: 48-hour full trial, then ¥49.9 one-time activation per device fingerprint purchased via Xiaohongshu; installation also possible via BRAT or manual download; full usage guide lives inside the plugin; warns against deleting or renaming its core folders (Work, Boxes, 读&写); weather uses open-meteo.
problem: Obsidian has no single sidebar dashboard that combines capture, task tracking, habit check-ins and vault statistics for daily routine use.
